name: manual_90990e
claim: Never paste a credential, token, API key, or secret into any repository, lesson, commit, review, or board note. No lesson from this branch has been published. A later redaction is not removal, because the patch still contains the value. Replace the unpublished commits so the value is absent before anyone publishes them.

decisions.notes: An unpublished memory lesson stored a live credential. The branch had no upstream. The redaction commit still showed the value in its patch, so both unpublished commits had to be replaced by one commit before publication.
